title: 4 Whether the church may ordaine ceremonies.

segments.text: THE church maie and ought to ordaine ceremonies; becauſe without defining and determining of circumſtaunces the Moral cannot be kept. There are notwithſtanding certaine conditions to bee obſerued by the Church in ordaining ceremonies, namely, They muſt bee ſuch ceremonies as are not impious, but agreeable to the word of the Lord. Secondly, they muſt not be ſuperſtitious, ſo that wee muſt not thinke them neceſſarie to be done: nether muſt they be done with offence. Thirdly, they muſt not be too many. 4. They muſt not be idle and vnprofitable, but muſt al tend to edifieng.
